name: US Army Combat Set US-01
scope: Photo-inspired cosmetic game clothing, not an authenticated issue-uniform reproduction.
example_skin: Hidden, non-exported reference. All groups named REF_* and REFERENCE_PLAYER_HIDE_FOR_EXPORT must be excluded from armor rendering/export. The player supplies the actual head, eyes and skin.
eyewear: Completely removed, including its geometry, texture and group.
integration: Free Model meshes. Attach clothing bones to the existing player pose using the supplied pivots; convert absolute mesh coordinates to bone-local coordinates if required by the renderer. Clothing registration, equipment slots, item icons, armor values and multiplayer are not implemented by this asset.
notes: The scarf deliberately leaves the upper face open.
The holster is a closed cosmetic pouch; no functional weapon model or item is included.
The optional rear pack is an original interpretation because the back is not visible in the supplied reference.
The demonstration animation is a fitting aid, not an in-game player animation replacement.
